name: Minion of the Mighty
oracle_text:
Menace
Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may put a Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
blocked_sentences: Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, you may put a Dragon creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

needs.what: a value reading the total power of the creatures you declared as attackers this combat, as they were when declared (a combat ledger of attacker power recorded at declare-attackers), usable as an intervening-if trigger condition `cmp >= 6`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attackers_this_turn` counts attacking creatures, not their power. `power_of` with `objects: {attacking: true, controller: you}` sums the LIVE power of creatures still attacking, so it reads differently from the printed card once an attacker is removed from combat, killed or shrunk in response to the trigger: the rulings say the creatures you attacked with still count at their declared power, and the intervening-if recheck on resolution would wrongly fail. It also counts by turn-free board state rather than 'this combat'.
